summary: Harmony Gold Mining, the South African gold producer, launched a US$500m guaranteed senior unsecured convertible bond due 2031, issued at 100% of principal (US$200,000 per bond). Coupon is guided at 1.500%-2.000% payable semi-annually from 29 March 2027, with redemption around 29 September 2031. Initial conversion price is set at a 35.0%-40.0% premium to the reference share price, implying roughly 18.9m shares, about 2.9% of current issued capital, at the 18 September 2026 close of ZAR319.71. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes; net share settlement is available. Watch pricing, final coupon and conversion premium, hedging-driven overhang, and dilution versus the balance-sheet optimisation rationale.
